egress.terms: unmetered; downloads redirect to a signed S3 URL (Backblaze-style hel1-dc4)

record.tooling: Plain HTTP PUT to a bin URL (curl -X PUT --data-binary @file -H 'filename: probe.bin' https://filebin.net/<bin>/probe.bin); the hosted service gates downloads behind bin approval. The Filebin server is also open source (github.com/espebra/filebin2, BSD-3) and can be self-hosted as a last resort.
record.chaining: Unlimited distinct bin IDs, each with its own 6-day clock. 'N bins x 6 days' is the only multiplication, and nothing survives week 2.

limits.value: retention from bin creation ('deleted automatically 6 days

record.limits_note: 6-day retention from bin creation ('deleted automatically 6 days from now' on the create page). Bin is created implicitly by the first PUT.
record.reliability_note: Bins are gated: the first-party FAQ shows a newly created bin as 'pending approval' with 'Downloads are not allowed as the bin is pending approval.' The self-hosted Filebin server source is published, but the hosted service at filebin.net applies the approval gate and 6-day expiry.

evidence.proved: 'deleted automatically 6 days from now', no-registration flow
